dedupe_keys.name: dun laoghaire harbour digitized sea level 1925 1931

description: PANGAEA publishes hourly sea-level values reconstructed from historical marigrams at Dún Laoghaire Harbour in Ireland for 1925–1931. The provider describes raw images, a traced grid, adjusted readings and a metadata readme; DataCite lists tab-separated text and CC BY 4.0. The record is publicly accessible without a fee. The authors digitized both the pen trace and reference grid to correct offsets, with a reported annual accuracy near 10 mm. These observations can calibrate harbour water-level boundary conditions and test historical coastal-flood models. They are one station and one early-twentieth-century interval, not a modern local surge forecast. Datums, gaps and the differences between raw and adjusted levels must be checked in the metadata file before asset-scale use. This measured series complements data-ipcc-ar6-sea-level-projections, which supplies future scenarios. No source image or data table was downloaded.
